question: India aims to increase its wind energy capacity from 42 GW to 140 GW by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2030**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India** has set an ambitious target to reach **500 GW** of non-fossil fuel-based energy capacity by the year **2030**, as part of its climate action commitments.
 
• Within this broader goal, the specific target for **wind energy** is to increase the cumulative installed capacity from its current level of approximately **42 GW** to **140 GW** by **2030**.
 
• As of **2023**, India's total installed wind power capacity stands at about **44.73 GW**, making it the **fourth-largest** in the world in terms of wind energy installation.
 
• The **Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)** has outlined a trajectory to bid out **50 GW** of renewable energy capacity annually from **FY 2023-24** to **FY 2027-28**, which includes a significant portion of wind power projects.
